description: A brown patterned long open robe with gold geometric woven borders lies over an ivory long tunic with a split round collar, embroidered front edging and long sleeves. A patterned gold-brown woven sash wraps the waist and falls in fringed ends. Ivory trousers and dark brown leather shoes show below the hems. Both hands hang visibly at the sides; no headgear or armor is present.
